static_traits.name: 刘娜
static_traits.social_status: Distant relationships with peers, difficulty establishing intimate relationships; has a few friends to confide in, but their understanding of the distress is limited
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without以往类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能具体描述体验；初始态度较为怀疑；常use绝对化与negate性表述（如“最差”“永远not会成功”）；配合度Average，能尝试但信心not足

basic_info.main_problem: 我几乎一直觉得自己是最糟糕的Graduate student，这导致Persistent self-doubt与without能感。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent self-doubt与负面自我认知已开始影响学业表现与心理健康，希望通过咨询加以改善。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成绩not达Anticipation，就说明我not适合这个领域、not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避继续学习或开始作业，陷入自我贬低和Withdrawal
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能在这个领域成功，我该现在就退学

special_situations.event: Seeing classmates more confident and skilled in class or during challenging academic periods
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人看起来更自信或更懂，就证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently comparing with others, reducing deep communication with classmates
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都知道在做什么，而我在瞎忙，我是最差的Graduate student

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must be perfect the first time, or it is failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会把它搞砸，开始也not用

special_situations.event: Receiving good grades or professors' positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面结果只是偶然，not具参考价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate正面证据，维持Self-doubt与负面自我评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这只是侥幸，not代表我有能力

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent, to have one's value and ability seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被证明without能、被同伴或导师negate
defense_goal: 通过自我批评、negate积极反馈与回避困难任务来降低被评判与失败的风险

object_relations.object_representation: Critical judges or more excellent peers/mentors

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to focus on positive evidence or suggests questioning negative beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些是自欺或not真实，积极反馈只是偶然，咨询师not理解她的真实not足
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静但坚决的语气强调“这只是运气/侥幸”，列举反例来削弱积极证据，同时表示“可以尝试但我not抱期待”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing starting a difficult academic task or being asked to try a new method
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将任务视为只能成功或彻底失败的考验，若not完美则证明自己without能
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化表述（如“要么成功要么失败”），推迟或回避行动，拒绝分步尝试。

manifestations: Living alone；难以与同伴建立亲密关系；在课前后与作业期间频繁Self-doubt并与他人比较，主观上感到与群体疏离

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“必须优秀/not能失败”的标准评价自我

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 启动任务前反复审视not足并因此回避
Dismisses positive feedback as 'luck' when receiving it

exception_events.target_problem: 在具有挑战性的学业任务或收到低于Anticipation成绩时，来访者通常会灾难化思维、产生强烈Anxiety并回避开始或持续完成作业，导致表现下降。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某些课程作业或考试中，来访者取得了好成绩并收到教授的正面评论；当时能够完成任务并Gaining recognition，呈现出与平时not同的更好结果。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同情境（任务更匹配能力）；not同做法（更为专注或按计划完成任务）；not同支持（教授的明确正向反馈增加了可见的成就证据）。

positive_force: Has obtained good grades and positive feedback from professors; there is objective evidence of competence
Willing to try counseling and reality testing, with willingness to change
Has a few friends to confide in; has some social support
Has tried positive self-talk and mindfulness practice, with self-help awareness
negative_force: Persistent comparison with others and dependence on external recognition
灾难化与全或without思维Reinforcement负面自我概念
启动任务的回避与拖延，短期缓解Anxiety但损害表现
将积极证据归因为侥幸，negate正向体验
Sleep and diet affected，降低精力与专注

target_behavior.behavior: 学业任务的启动回避与拖延（伴随强烈Anxiety与Self-denial）
antecedent: When reviewing notes before or after class
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化认知与全或without标准，加之与同伴比较引发的自卑与without能感
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的失败与负性评价，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance，难以与同伴建立关系，Sleep and eating habits affected，Persistent self-doubt
